Anchored.summary: Determines whether a part is immovable by physics.

AssemblyAngularVelocity.summary: The angular velocity of the part's assembly.

AssemblyCenterOfMass.summary: The center of mass of the part's assembly in world space.

AssemblyLinearVelocity.summary: The linear velocity of the part's assembly.

AssemblyMass.summary: The total mass of the part's assembly.

AssemblyRootPart.summary: A reference to the root part of the assembly.

AudioCanCollide.summary: Determines whether the part will physically interact with audio simulation, similar to `Class.BasePart.CastShadow|CastShadow` for lighting.

BackParamA.summary: Determines the first parameter for the SurfaceType on the Back face of a part.

BackParamB.summary: Determines the second parameter for the SurfaceType on the Back face of a part.

BackSurface.summary: Determines the type of surface for the back face of a part.

BackSurfaceInput.summary: Determines the kind of input for the Back face of a part.

BottomParamA.summary: Determines the first parameter for the SurfaceType on the Bottom face of a part.

BottomParamB.summary: Determines the second parameter for the SurfaceType on the Bottom face of a part.

BottomSurface.summary: Determines the type of surface for the bottom face of a part.

BottomSurfaceInput.summary: Determines the kind of input for the Bottom face of a part.

BrickColor.summary: Determines the color of a part.

CFrame.summary: Determines the position and orientation of the `Class.BasePart` in the world.

CanCollide.summary: Determines whether a part may collide with other parts.

CanQuery.summary: Determines whether the part is considered during spatial query operations.

CanTouch.summary: Determines if `Class.BasePart.Touched|Touched` and `Class.BasePart.TouchEnded|TouchEnded` events fire on the part.

CastShadow.summary: Determines whether or not a part casts a shadow.

CenterOfMass.summary: Describes the world position in which a part's center of mass is located.

CollisionGroup.summary: Describes the name of a part's collision group.

CollisionGroupId.summary: Describes the automatically set ID number of a part's collision group.

Color.summary: Determines the color of a part.

CurrentPhysicalProperties.summary: Indicates the current physical properties of the part.

CustomPhysicalProperties.summary: Determines several physical properties of a part.

Elasticity.summary: Used to control the Elasticity of the part, but it no longer does anything.

EnableFluidForces.summary: Used to enable or disable aerodynamic forces on parts and assemblies.

ExtentsCFrame.summary: The `Datatype.CFrame` of the physical extents of the `Class.BasePart`.

ExtentsSize.summary: The actual physical size of the `Class.BasePart` as regarded by the physics engine.

Friction.summary: Used to control the Friction of the part, but now it no longer does anything.

FrontParamA.summary: Determines the first parameter for the SurfaceType on the Front face of a part.

FrontParamB.summary: Determines the second parameter for the SurfaceType on the Front face of a part.

FrontSurface.summary: Determines the type of surface for the front face of a part.

FrontSurfaceInput.summary: Determines the kind of input for the Front face of a part (-Z direction).

LeftParamA.summary: Determines the first parameter for the SurfaceType on the Left face of a part.

LeftParamB.summary: Determines the second parameter for the SurfaceType on the Left face of a part.

LeftSurface.summary: Determines the type of surface for the left face of a part.

LeftSurfaceInput.summary: Determines the kind of input for the Left face of a part.

LocalTransparencyModifier.summary: Determines a multiplier for `Class.BasePart.Transparency` that is only visible to the local client.

Locked.summary: Determines whether a part is selectable in Studio.

Mass.summary: Describes the mass of the part, the product of its density and volume.

Massless.summary: Determines whether the part contributes to the total mass or inertia of its rigid body.

Material.summary: Determines the texture and default physical properties of a part.

Orientation.summary: Describes the rotation of the part in the world.

PivotOffset.summary: Specifies the offset of the part's pivot from its `Datatype.CFrame`.

Position.summary: Describes the position of the part in the world.

ReceiveAge.summary: Time since last recorded physics update.

Reflectance.summary: Determines how much a part reflects the skybox.

ResizeIncrement.summary: Describes the smallest change in size allowable by the `Class.BasePart:Resize()|Resize()` method.

ResizeableFaces.summary: Describes the faces on which a part may be resized.

RightParamA.summary: Determines the first parameter for the SurfaceType on the Right face of a part.

RightParamB.summary: Determines the second parameter for the SurfaceType on the Right face of a part.

RightSurface.summary: Determines the type of surface for the right face of a part.

RightSurfaceInput.summary: Determines the kind of input for the Right face of a part (-X direction).

RootPriority.summary: The main rule in determining the root part of an assembly.

RotVelocity.summary: Determines a part's change in orientation over time.

Rotation.summary: The rotation of the part in degrees for the three axes.

Size.summary: Determines the dimensions of a part (length, height, width).

SpecificGravity.summary: The ratio of the part's density to the density of water determined by the `Class.BasePart.Material`.

TopParamA.summary: Determines the first parameter for the SurfaceType on the Top face of a part.

TopParamB.summary: Determines the second parameter for the SurfaceType on the Top face of a part.

TopSurface.summary: Determines the type of surface for the top face of a part.

TopSurfaceInput.summary: Determines the kind of input for the Top face of a part (+Y direction).

Transparency.summary: Determines how much a part can be seen through (the inverse of part opacity).

Velocity.summary: Determines a part's change in position over time.

Archivable.summary: Determines if an `Class.Instance` and its descendants can be cloned using `Class.Instance:Clone()`, and can be saved/published.

Parent.summary: Determines the hierarchical parent of the `Class.Instance`.

LevelOfDetail.summary: Sets the level of detail on the model for experiences with instance streaming enabled.

ModelStreamingMode.summary: Controls the model streaming behavior on `Class.Model|Models` when instance streaming is enabled.

PrimaryPart.summary: The primary part of the `Class.Model`, or `nil` if not explicitly set.

Scale.summary: Editor-only property used to scale the model around its pivot. Setting this property will move the scale as though `Class.Model:ScaleTo()` was called on it.

WorldPivot.summary: Determines where the pivot of a `Class.Model` which does **not** have a set `Class.Model.PrimaryPart` is located.

Origin.summary: Editor-only property that reads and sets the world `Datatype.CFrame` of the `Class.PVInstance`'s pivot, moving the entire instance when changed from the Studio

Pivot Offset.summary: Editor-only property that displays and edits the pivot's `Datatype.CFrame` relative to the instance, moving only the pivot and leaving the instance in place.

Shape.summary: Sets the overall shape of the object.
